sources.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTA 6 Trophy List, all 55 trophies (PSNProfiles, TrueAchievements)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first and this one pops on its own. There is nothing extra to do, so follow the roadmap stages in order and it unlocks at the very end.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission in Chapter 1. It cannot be missed, the trophy pops when the mission ends.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through the opening missions until Chapter 1 closes. The trophy pops at the end of the chapter, nothing special is needed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Keep playing the main missions until Chapter 2 ends. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops when the chapter's final mission is done.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It pops at the end of the chapter.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the game. It pops after the last mission ends and is one of the two Gold trophies in the list.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist mission in Chapter 3. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the Child's Play mission in Chapter 4. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the Headliners mission in Chapter 4. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the Operation Savage Glory mission in Chapter 5. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the 100 percent checklist under Progress, Stats, 100 percent Completion after the story. It is closer to 60 percent true completion: scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish 70 of 80 challenges, and work through the robberies and activities. Most of it comes from the other trophies, so save this push for after the story.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to build the count. Track progress in Progress, Activities, Stunts.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, car races and drone races, plus stunts. The tracker sits in Progress, Activities. Most of them happen naturally while you work on the other trophies.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges at the 12 ranges. The golds here are forgiving, and range practice also raises your Focus level for the Gunslinger trophy.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations, 42 races in total. You only need one win per location, not every race.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. They must be 20 distinct race locations, not the same race 20 times.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you a fishing spot. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are on the TV at home, the fourth is on arcade machines around the map. Finish all levels once, you do not need to beat every challenge.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-mission questline, Lucia only: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. It starts with a call from Andy in Chapter 3 and stays available after the story.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline: clear 7 shipwrecks by diving for his treasures. It starts in Chapter 1 in Key Lento. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapter 2 or 3, so nothing here is missable.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-mission questline at the Thrillbilly Mud Club: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. It starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands that count toward this trophy. Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count. Note that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. Track the count in the trophy list.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver the 16 sports cars he asks for. It starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, when you get the Key Cloner. Stolen cars can be delivered to his garage in west Vice City.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, Jason only: destroy the Synthetic Labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter mission, then do the Spin On This mission. It starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Doing a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts double. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends, it may be required and it disappears after the chapter. You cannot do the last spot until both characters can play together after Coffee Break.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Do Bret Vogel's hunting questline, Jason only. It starts with a text from Bret after Coffee Break. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. The unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 helps, and the 15 Target Decks count toward 100 percent.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida, so pick the three easiest to finish.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app. Any 100 count: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. There are more than 100 in the world, so just scan as you travel.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. You need 70 of 80 for 100 percent, so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road. Pick the easiest ones first.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then escape the heat zone. It works best after Coffee Break, when you can call your partner. It also pops naturally during the bank vault robberies in Chapter 4.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping a wanted level the whole time. Do not let the wanted level drop between shops. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app. Just stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic. You need 200 for 100 percent, so this one comes first.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill or incapacitate 5 enemies inside one use of Combat Focus (L3 plus R3 while aiming). Raise your Focus level first with shooting ranges, golf, pool or fishing, eat or use Adrenaline to stretch the window, and use an assault rifle at a gang operation.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, terminals E3 and E4 are easiest. Get in the cockpit, drive it back to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the south-west edge of the map. Enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, rob a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun so no alarm trips. Find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape each time. They unlock after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is. Follow a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. All 8 are needed for 100 percent.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat radius. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, or earlier by blocking a truck, planting a sticky bomb on its back door and escaping.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map. Fly a plane over every fogged area until the map is fully revealed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs, 39 operations in total. They show as yellow icons when you get near them. All 39 are needed for 100 percent, so this pops on the way.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it by the bar.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After getting the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. Only that blue Banshee counts, and the pop is slightly delayed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation, steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun in the north-east, and the safe in the north-east hallway, blown open with sticky bombs. Escape the police to pop it.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out together at a fitness club, call your partner first so both train at once, or work out at home after the story. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications. Robberies, fights and escapes all count, and the total builds up passively while you chase the other trophies.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet confirmed, believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. No verified method exists yet, so check the guide again once more players have finished the game.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: at night after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is there, follow the path into the woods to the UFO, approach it, talk to the woman it drops and help her back to her car.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet confirmed, believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, a melee drive-by. No verified method exists yet, so check the guide again once more players have finished the game.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through a fence, Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery. The total counts across all robberies.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Buy garages first, Little Boxes, for parking spots, then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
